records.context: Offer these controls only to the compatible Qt paint engines.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.PreferencesDialog._build_the_dialog._sync_popup_motion#0
records.source: Offer these controls only to the compatible Qt paint engines.
records.translation: 仅为兼容的 Qt 绘制引擎提供这些控件。

records.context: The settings-window backdrop has its own choice and remains active when module animation is off unless its own choice is None.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.apply_ambient_preferences#2
records.source: The settings-window backdrop has its own choice and remains active when module animation is off unless its own choice is None.
records.translation: 设置窗口的背景有独立的选项；模块动画关闭时，它仍保持活动，除非它自己的选项为 None。

records.context: Turning module animation back *on* only resumes the widgets that are actually on application view. Every module application view keeps its ambient widget alive while the user is on some other tab, and un-pausing those would spend frames on pixels nobody can see — which is the one thing this animation is not allowed to do. Their own ``showEvent`` restarts them when the tab comes back.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.apply_ambient_preferences#3
records.source: Turning module animation back *on* only resumes the widgets that are actually on screen. Every module screen keeps its ambient widget alive while the user is on some other tab, and un-pausing those would spend frames on pixels nobody can see — which is the one thing this animation is not allowed to do. Their own ``showEvent`` restarts them when the tab comes back.
records.translation: 重新*开启*模块动画时，只恢复屏幕上实际可见的控件。用户切换到其他标签页时，各模块界面仍保留其背景控件；恢复这些控件会为无人能看到的像素耗费帧数，而这种动画不允许这样做。标签页重新出现时，它们自己的 ``showEvent`` 会重新启动它们。

records.context: Which animation screens paint in the active launch mode.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.get_ambient_theme#0
records.source: Which animation screens paint in the active launch mode.
records.translation: 当前启动模式下各界面绘制哪种动画。

records.context: Persist an animation offered in the active launch mode.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.set_ambient_theme#0
records.source: Persist an animation offered in the active launch mode.
records.translation: 保存当前启动模式提供的一种动画。

records.context: an animation offered in the current launcher's menu.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.set_ambient_theme#2
records.source: an animation offered in the current launcher's menu.
records.translation: 当前启动器菜单提供的一种动画。

records.context: independent field-wave switch; ``None`` reads Preferences.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AmbientWidget#15
records.source: independent field-wave switch; ``None`` reads Preferences.
records.translation: 独立的场波纹开关；``None`` 表示读取偏好设置。

records.context: popup waves per minute, clamped to zero through sixty; zero disables recurring waves. The separate ripple switch controls discrete click, container and window feedback.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AmbientWidget.set_popup_wave_frequency#1
records.source: popup waves per minute, clamped to zero through sixty; zero disables recurring waves. The separate ripple switch controls discrete click, container and window feedback.
records.translation: 每分钟的弹出窗口波纹数，限制在零到六十之间；零禁用周期性波纹。独立的波纹开关控制点击、容器及窗口产生的单次反馈。

records.context: Switch all field ripples independently of mouse gravity and dragging.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AmbientWidget.set_ripples_enabled#0
records.source: Switch all field ripples independently of mouse gravity and dragging.
records.translation: 独立于鼠标引力和拖动，开启或关闭所有场波纹。

records.context: whether recurring and discrete field waves are enabled.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AmbientWidget.set_ripples_enabled#1
records.source: whether recurring and discrete field waves are enabled.
records.translation: 是否启用周期性和单次场波纹。

records.context: Standard launches preserve the requested pair. A Spaceout launch uses its own stored selection, or defaults to the fractal before one is saved.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.dressed#1
records.source: Standard launches preserve the requested pair. A Spaceout launch uses its own stored selection, or defaults to the fractal before one is saved.
records.translation: 标准启动保留请求的配对。Spaceout 启动使用其独立保存的选择；尚未保存选择时，默认使用分形。
records.retired_reason: Superseded by current Spaceout evolving-field defaults or the source-verified Lorenz group-size outlier filter. Original source-bound evidence retained in place.

records.context: the requested theme name, not validated here.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.dressed#2
records.source: the requested theme name, not validated here.
records.translation: 请求的主题名称，此处不进行验证。

records.source: Publish settled window or panel feedback to its visible field backdrop.
records.translation: 将已完成调整的窗口或面板的反馈传递到其可见的场背景。

records.source: the resized, moved or collapsed widget.

records.source: an optional snapped window side.
records.translation: 可选的已贴边窗口侧边。

records.source: optional final rectangle in widget-local coordinates.
records.translation: 可选的最终矩形，使用控件局部坐标。

records.source: positive enables release feedback; zero disables it.
records.translation: 正值启用释放反馈；零禁用该反馈。

records.context: Bounded to four lines: the strip used to take whatever height the longest help needed, so moving the pointer between two controls whose help differs in length made the whole dialog jump. The full text is still in the register and accessible description when it runs long.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.hint_bar.HintBar#4
records.source: Bounded to four lines: the strip used to take whatever height the longest help needed, so moving the pointer between two controls whose help differs in length made the whole dialog jump. The full text is still in the register and accessible description when it runs long.
records.translation: 限制为四行：之前，提示条会采用最长帮助文本所需的高度，因此指针在帮助文本长度不同的两个控件之间移动时，整个对话框都会跳动。文本较长时，完整文本仍保留在登记表和无障碍描述中。
records.retired_reason: Superseded by the current scrollable help strip and its retained full text. Original source-bound evidence retained in place.

records.source: Keep the reserved four lines in sync with the painted font.
records.translation: 使预留的四行与绘制时使用的字体保持同步。

records.context: the Qt font or style change event.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.hint_bar.HintBar.changeEvent#1
records.source: the Qt font or style change event.
records.translation: Qt 字体或样式更改事件。
